blockers.title: filesystemMeasurementTarget is ordered before selection but still has no deterministic target-path or process source
evidence: filesystemMeasurementTarget.rule defines the target circularly as 'the host volume that will bind every relevant resolution' but declares no targetPath field, signed source, canonical path, or derivation such as an installation root or initial executable. The Linux recordSelection requires 'the target path', which occurs nowhere else as a value a verifier can obtain.

resolutionPredicate now correctly orders target observation before profile selection, but that ordering does not tell two verifiers which of several observable host volumes to inspect. The later population packet supplies selector values only and is forbidden to mint selector semantics.

The Linux source names 'the resolving process's mount namespace' and '/proc/self/mountinfo of that process' before any later object resolution. It does not identify which process supplies the preselection namespace, how an independent observer binds /proc/self to that process, or what happens when descendants/helpers resolve in another namespace.
blockers.impact: Two conforming verifiers can choose different valid target paths or process namespaces, compute different required filesystem members, and select different complete profiles even though every named observation subsequently succeeds.
blockers.requiredRepair: Define one immutable preselection target source and include or bind it in the signed profile/carrier: for example a canonical installation/executable root with exact path-resolution rules. Name the initial process or namespace identity used on Linux and an observer-safe source such as the bound process's mountinfo; require later resolvers to remain in that namespace or refuse. Fail closed if the target path/source itself is absent or non-unique.

shouldFix.title: sonameAbi is metadata-only, but companionObservation has no defined place in the retained trace schema
shouldFix.evidence: V8 now deterministically says sonameAbi never changes allow/refuse and is retained as companionObservation. loaderTraces.retainedEventSchema still lists taggedEvidenceForm and its other event fields but no companionObservation field or nested location. /loaderTraces was not on the v8 change roster and is semantically unchanged from v7, so the retention representation was not actually added.
shouldFix.impact: One trace producer can invent a top-level field, another can nest it under taggedEvidenceForm, and another can omit it while each claims to follow the metadata-only rule.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Add companionObservation with explicit optionality and closed shape to retainedEventSchema, or state its exact nested path inside taggedEvidenceForm and require retention there. If retention is not required, remove the retention claim.
